subject: Important Update on Your Recent Purchase
body: Dear valued customer, We wanted to inform you that there has been a delay in the processing of your recent purchase order. Our team is working diligently to resolve this issue and ensure that your order is fulfilled as soon as possible. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your patience. Should you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact our customer support team. Thank you for choosing our services.
